decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit is very close to the firm's established know-how in plural-component, pumping and injection equipment, so management is likely to keep it and learn from early market use.

As another resin injection unit within the firm's core application-technology domain, it fits existing engineering, production and service capabilities and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's longstanding spray-equipment business, where its absorptive capacity and customer knowledge are strongest.
A manual airless spray gun is highly related to the firm's existing products, channels and service base, so management would usually retain it unless clear failure emerged.

This air-assisted airless spray gun line builds directly on the firm's core spraying expertise and, as a multi-model line, likely reflects a deliberate platform commitment rather than an easy candidate for exit.

The data logger complements coating equipment and could strengthen the firm's solutions offering, but it is less central than its mechanical equipment and therefore faces a higher withdrawal risk if learning or adoption is weak.
